html: <sherpa-select-checkbox data-label="Accept terms" data-description="Required to continue." name="terms">
use: For one tick box with a label; `indeterminate` shows a mixed state, and `data-advanced` adds a menu of selection choices such as "Select all on page". For several options under one label, use `sherpa-select-group` with `multiple`; for an on/off that applies at once, use `sherpa-switch`.
